Test Scenario: AC1 & AC2 (Normal): Tech Support lists all equipment requests with search/filter
Pre-condition: Tech Support authenticated; multiple requests exist
Test Steps:
1. Sign in as Tech Support.
2. Navigate to Equipment Management.
3. View list and filter by event.
Expected Result: List displays all requests with status, specs, event details.

Test Scenario: AC3 (Normal): Tech Support updates status from PENDING to PREPARING
Test Steps:
1. Select request.
2. Change status to PREPARING.
3. Save.
Expected Result: Status updated to PREPARING in database.

Test Scenario: AC3 (Normal): Tech Support updates status from PREPARING to READY
Test Steps:
1. Select request.
2. Change status to READY.
3. Save.

Test Scenario: AC3 (Normal): Tech Support updates status from READY to RETURNED
Test Steps:
1. Select request.
2. Change status to RETURNED.
3. Save.

Test Scenario: AC4 (Normal): Tech Support adds internal notes or specs updates
Test Steps:
1. Open request detail.
2. Add notes: 'Checked cable continuity'.
3. Save.
Expected Result: Notes saved and visible on request record.

Test Scenario: AC5 (Normal): Coordinator receives in-app notice when status becomes READY
Test Steps:
1. Tech Support marks request READY.
2. Coordinator checks notifications.
Expected Result: Coordinator receives notification that equipment is READY.
